fact: ARPCE's postal regulation director reported progress on the national digital addressing platform, provisionally named Système de localisation mixte, which was demonstrated at a steering committee meeting on 9 October 2024 ahead of a final presentation to the authorities in November.

ARPCE's postal regulation director presented the digital postal addressing project, run with town halls and partner administrations, in Brazzaville on 15 October 2026; it was launched in April 2022 and has had a legal framework since July 2025 in the decree on national postal codification.

Arpce presented the results of its digital postal addressing project in Brazzaville on 15 October 2026; its postal regulation director said it will help identify and locate people, households, firms and infrastructure across the national territory.
